name: Tarok Slovenian
description: Slovenian Tarok is the most popular parlour game in Slovenia, a point trick-taking game with bidding closely related to Austrian Tarock. 54 cards: 8 per suit (Clubs, Spades, Hearts, Diamonds) plus 22 trumps (taroks). Highest trump Å kis, then Mond (XXI), lowest trump (I). Black suits K-Q-Knight-J-10-9-8-7; red K-Q-Knight-J-1-2-3-4. Kings, Å kis, Mond, lowest trump 5 pts each; Queens 4, Knights 3, Jacks 2, others 1. Four players; dealer gives 12 cards each in two batches of 6 (counter-clockwise), 6 in talon. Bidding from Three up to Valat Without. With three/two/one declarer calls a King for secret partner. Declarer's side wins by taking more than half the card points.

setup.players: Four players. The four-player version is the most popular form for social play; one player is dealer, and partnerships are determined by bidding and by calling a King in three, two, or one contracts.
setup.dealing: First 6 cards to talon; then 12 cards each in two batches of 6, counter-clockwise starting to dealer's right.

rules.objective: In positive contracts (three, two, one, solo): declarer's side wins by taking at least 36 of 70 card points. In klop avoid taking points; in beggar-type contracts take no tricks; in valat take all tricks.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: 6 to talon, 12 each in packets of 6 counter-clockwise. 2. Bidding: Forehand waits; others bid or pass; highest bidder is declarer. 3. Calling: In three/two/one declarer calls a king; holder is secret partner. 4. Talon exchange: Declarer takes 3, 2 or 1 card(s) per contract and discards same number. 5. Announcements: Bonuses (trula, kings, lowest-trump ultimo) or kontra. 6. Play: Forehand leads (or declarer in beggar+). Follow suit; if unable play trump. Highest trump wins. 7. Scoring: Contract plus difference and bonuses; cumulative; game ends by škis round or target.
keyRules: Must follow suit; if unable must play a trump. Trick won by highest trump or highest of led suit.
Declarer's side needs 36+ of 70 card points to win positive contracts.
Kings, Škis, Mond, lowest trump 5 pts each; Queens 4, Knights 3, Jacks 2; others 1.
Emperor trick: if Škis, Mond and lowest trump in same trick, lowest trump wins.
